memes.alt: A living room christmas tree decorated with little red candles. Under it, between wrapped presents, DUK lies flat with a gift tag on him: to: you. from: the floor.

memes.title: season's greetings from the family.
memes.alt: A holiday card with a red and green border: season's greetings from the family. Three smiling stick-figure relatives stand with arms up for the photo while DUK lies flat on the floor in front of them. (duk is fine.)

memes.title: year in review: ducked 365 times.
memes.alt: A big year in review card: 2026. times ducked: 365. times unduckable: 0. times got back up: 365. face changed: no. DUK lies flat underneath it.

memes.title: your top move: the position.
memes.alt: A loud year-end wrapped style story card in pink and lime: your 2026, wrapped. your top move: the position. DUK lies flat across the bottom in the duk pose.

memes.title: 2026 photo dump.
memes.alt: A 2026 photo dump of twelve polaroids, one per month, from snowy january to summer beach to red candles in the fall. In every single photo DUK is lying flat in the duk pose.

memes.title: new year's resolution: same.
memes.alt: A notebook page titled 2027 resolutions. 1. stop ducking, crossed out. 1. duck less, crossed out. Then in big letters: 1. same. DUK lies flat in the corner of the page.

memes.title: new year's eve: 11:59 pm. duk hour.
memes.alt: A navy and gold new year's eve party schedule: 10:00 pm snacks, 11:00 pm small talk, 11:59 pm duk hour (highlighted), 12:00 am get up. DUK stands beside it, blank.

memes.title: the ball is dropping. duk.
memes.alt: New year's eve at midnight: a giant glittering ball drops down its pole toward the crowd with a countdown board reading 00:00:03. Stick-figure crowd cheers with arms up. DUK lies flat in the front row.

memes.title: midnight. loud things in the sky. duk.
memes.alt: Midnight on a rooftop: fireworks explode in red, yellow, green and white across the night sky while DUK lies flat on the roof in the duk pose, staring. Caption: 12:00 am. duk.

memes.title: new year. new me.
memes.alt: Two side by side photos labelled 2026 me and 2027 me. In both, DUK is lying flat on the floor in the exact same duk pose with the exact same face. Caption: new year. new me.

comics.title: duk #1: support's here.
comics.alt: A stick-figure trader points at a whiteboard chart and says support is here. The red line breaks through, so he draws support lower. In the last panel he lies on the floor next to DUK, tapping the floor: support is here.

comics.title: duk #2: gm.
comics.alt: Two ducks greet each other: duk. duk. In the third panel a black cat-shaped kol silhouette sits between them and says gm frens. Both ducks are already flat on the floor.

comics.title: duk #3: it's a pool.
comics.alt: The trader asks DUK, floating in a pool, whether the pool is a price floor. DUK: no, it is a pool. The trader asks what the floor is for, then. Last panel: DUK is out of the water, dripping, lying flat on the floor.

comics.title: duk #4: i live here.
comics.alt: The trader stands on a couch shouting the floor is lava. DUK lies flat on the floor. The trader points: you have to get off the floor. DUK, still flat: i live here.

comics.title: duk #5: guys??
comics.alt: A 2006-style group chat called the pond. The trader posts: guys its dumping, like a lot. Then: guys?? what do we do. The last panel is five duck avatars replying duk. duk. duk. duk. duk.

comics.title: duk #6: he gets it.
comics.alt: Lesson one. DUK tells a duckling the market throws stuff at you. Some fight it: a stick figure wrestles a giant red candle. Some try to predict it: he scribbles lines on a chart. Last panel: the duckling is already flat on the floor as a candle flies over, and DUK says ok, he gets it.

comics.title: duk #7: my floor.
comics.alt: Inside an elevator, the floor display drops from 40 to 12 to B3. The trader gets more and more panicked. In the last panel DUK is lying flat on the elevator floor and says my floor.

comics.title: duk #8: drill passed.
comics.alt: Duk drill. An instructor duck tells a row of small ducks: when you hear this is the bottom, you duk. In the third panel the cat-shaped kol walks in saying this is the bottom, and every duck, instructor included, is already flat.

comics.title: duk #9: doing the other side.
comics.alt: Saturday. DUK lies on his back on a striped towel in the sun, feet in the air. A phone next to him buzzes: market -30%. Last panel: he has rolled over into THE DUK, face down, and says doing the other side.

comics.title: duk #10: burned.
comics.alt: The trader asks where the creator fees go; DUK says after graduation they help add duk and sol to the pool. The trader asks about the lp from each add. Last panel: they sit by a small campfire with a big lp token burning in it. Caption: burned. receipts on duk.fun.

comics.title: duk #11: it's me.
comics.alt: The trader opens a door and says gm. Three ducks are already flat on the floor. He says guys, its me; they stay flat. He tries duk. All three ducks are standing, and one says duk.

comics.title: duk #12: nvm.
comics.alt: Four panels at a desk. The trader says it's over, then it's so over, while DUK hides under the desk. The chart turns green, the trader cheers we're so back and DUK stands up. Last panel: the chart is red again, DUK is already back under the desk, and the trader just says nvm.

comics.title: duk #13: sir.
comics.alt: A stick-figure cashier behind a counter says that'll be $84. DUK stares. Second panel: silence, just the till showing $84. Last panel: DUK is flat on the floor in front of the counter and the cashier says sir.

comics.title: duk #14: the quote was optimistic.
comics.alt: Close-up of a phone: on paper the bag is up 400 percent. After slippage the sell shows plus 12 percent. The trader stares at his phone and DUK, beside him, says the quote was optimistic.

comics.title: duk #15: same time next week.
comics.alt: DUK lies on a green therapy couch. The stick-figure therapist asks how the market makes him feel. DUK stares. Last panel: DUK is flat on the floor in front of the couch, and the therapist says same time next week.

comics.title: duk #16: welcome.
comics.alt: Four group chat panels. The trader asks should i buy the dip: duk. Should i sell: duk. That is not an answer: duk. Finally the trader types duk. and the duck replies welcome.

gifs.title: duk.
gifs.alt: DUK stands staring, crouches, and slams flat on the floor in THE DUK pose as a giant "duk." hits the screen, then gets back up like nothing happened.

gifs.title: slow blink
gifs.alt: Extreme close-up of DUK staring straight at you. Nothing happens. He blinks once, very slowly.

gifs.title: duk (whoosh)
gifs.alt: A red candle comes flying in at head height; DUK drops flat just in time, it whooshes over him, and he stands back up blank.

gifs.title: get up.
gifs.alt: DUK lies flat next to a snapped red candle, gets up in three awkward steps, brushes himself off once and stares at you: "get up."

gifs.title: noted.
gifs.alt: Close-up of DUK nodding twice, slowly, with no expression: "noted."

gifs.title: no.
gifs.alt: Close-up of DUK slowly shaking his head side to side, completely blank: "no."

gifs.title: ok.
gifs.alt: DUK holds up a cardboard sign and flips it around to read "ok.", then flips it back.

gifs.title: sweating
gifs.alt: A monitor keeps printing red candles. DUK stands next to it staring straight at you while big sweat drops roll off his head.

gifs.title: timber
gifs.alt: DUK stands there, then tips over sideways like a plank, bounces once, lies flat staring, and swings back up.

gifs.title: anyway.
gifs.alt: Side view of DUK waddling across the screen and out of frame, tail wagging, not looking back: "anyway."

gifs.title: peek
gifs.alt: DUK's head slides out from behind a wall, stares at you, blinks once, and slides back behind it.

gifs.title: duk. duk.
gifs.alt: Two DUKs face each other. One bows: "duk." The other bows back: "duk." The greeting.

gifs.title: popcorn
gifs.alt: DUK holds a striped popcorn bucket and keeps feeding himself popcorn, staring straight at you like you are the show.

gifs.title: fees go in the pool
gifs.alt: DUK lies at the bottom of an empty pool. A pipe labelled "fees" pours water in, the pool fills up and he floats up to the top, bobbing. Then the view slides over to the next empty pool, where he is lying on the bottom again.

gifs.title: typing
gifs.alt: DUK behind a desk hammering a keyboard with both wings, keys flying off, face completely blank.

gifs.title: unbothered
gifs.alt: Red candles, liquidation notices, rent bills and FUD rain down around DUK while he lies flat in THE DUK pose, staring at you, unbothered.

gifs.title: gm
gifs.alt: Half-asleep DUK holds a steaming "duk" mug, slowly lifts it to his bill for a long sip, and lowers it again: "gm".

gifs.title: gn
gifs.alt: DUK reaches up and pulls the cord on a bare light bulb. Lights off; only his eyes are left staring at you in the dark. They close, then slowly open again: "gn".

gifs.title: mind blown
gifs.alt: Close-up of DUK. The top of his head blasts off in a cartoon explosion while his face stays perfectly blank; then it drops back on.

gifs.title: ha.
gifs.alt: Close-up of DUK. His bill opens exactly once for a single deadpan "ha." and shuts again. Eyes never move.
